name: Kunadacs (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of blue and red at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Kunadacs (a blue and red shield with a yellow crozier, a plough and ears of grain) above a yellow scroll inscribed KUNADACS.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
